title: Apple Icon Composer Icon
description: Schema for Apple Icon Composer .icon package icon.json files. Covers Icon Composer 1.x documents and the Icon Composer 2.0 additions (document 'features', group 'blur-material' / 'refractivity' / 'specular-highlight-placement', whole-object '-specializations' for shadow and translucency, asset mirroring, and idiom / localization specialization slots).

features.description: Document capabilities that a reader must understand to open this icon (Icon Composer 2.0+). Icon Composer refuses to open a document declaring a feature it does not know, so this is the forward-compatibility gate: Icon Composer 2 writes it when the icon uses the matching keys.

fill.description: Background fill for the icon (used when fill-specializations is not present)

color-space-for-untagged-svg-colors.description: Color space to use for SVG colors that don't specify one

implicit-asset-mirroring.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. UI 'Mirror Assets in Right to Left' — automatically mirror assets for right-to-left languages unless a layer or group opts out via 'asset-mirroring'.

languages.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Locale IDs this document carries localized assets for (Icon Composer shows this as an internal-only setting).

groups.description: Ordered list of layer groups composing the icon

allOf.$comment: Icon Composer 2 declares 'refractivity' in 'features' whenever a group carries any refractivity key, so that Icon Composer 1.x refuses the document instead of silently dropping the effect.
Same gate for the specular highlight placement introduced with Icon Composer 2.

features.description: Feature names understood by Icon Composer 2.0. Any other value makes Icon Composer refuse the document with 'This document uses features from a newer version of Icon Composer'.

color.description: A color string. Either 'colorspace:component,...' — 'extended-srgb', 'srgb' and 'display-p3' take exactly 4 components (r,g,b,a), 'gray' and 'extended-gray' exactly 2 (white,alpha) — or 'named:<system color>'. Examples: 'extended-srgb:0.00000,0.53333,1.00000,1.00000', 'display-p3:1.00000,0.18845,0.18108,1.00000', 'extended-gray:1.00000,1.00000', 'named:system-blue'.

oneOf.$comment: RGB color spaces: exactly four components.
Gray color spaces: exactly two components.
System colors, which adapt to the appearance.

appearance.description: The appearance this specialization applies to. Omitting the 'appearance' key targets every appearance; 'base' is the value all appearances inherit from, and 'light' may also be specified explicitly.

idiom.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. The idiom (platform shape) this specialization applies to. Omit to apply to every idiom.

specialization-entry.description: One entry of a '-specializations' array: a required 'value' plus the slot it applies to. A slot is any combination of 'appearance', 'idiom' and 'localization'; every key omitted means 'applies to all'.

localization.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Locale ID (e.g. 'ja', 'ar') this specialization applies to.

gradient-point.description: A normalized point (0 to 1 on each axis) on the icon canvas, used for gradient endpoints

gradient-orientation.description: Start and stop points defining a linear gradient's direction. Icon Composer emits this alongside 'linear-gradient' when the gradient is rotated.

fill-keyword.description: A fill expressed as a keyword rather than an object: 'automatic' inherits the value it specializes, 'none' paints nothing, and 'system-light' / 'system-dark' use Apple's standard backgrounds.

fill-object.description: A fill definition. Exactly one of the fill type properties should be present.

automatic-gradient.description: An automatic gradient derived from a single base color

linear-gradient.description: A linear gradient defined by two color stops

orientation.description: Direction of a 'linear-gradient' fill, as start/stop points. Only valid alongside 'linear-gradient'.

fill-value.description: A fill: either a fill object or one of the fill keywords.

specializations-of-fill.description: Slot-specific fill overrides. Each entry's 'value' may be a fill object or a fill keyword such as 'automatic'.

specializations-of-string.description: Slot-specific string overrides (e.g. image file name)

specializations-of-shadow.description: Slot-specific shadow overrides. Each 'value' is a complete shadow object — Icon Composer has no nested 'shadow.kind-specializations'.

specializations-of-translucency.description: Slot-specific translucency overrides. Each 'value' is a complete translucency object.

specializations-of-refractivity.description: Slot-specific refractivity overrides. Each 'value' is a complete refractivity object.

position.description: Position and scale adjustments for a layer or group. When present, both 'scale' and 'translation-in-points' are required: Icon Composer refuses to open a package whose position omits 'translation-in-points'. Omit the whole 'position' object for the identity transform (scale 1, no translation).

scale.description: Scale factor for the layer (1.0 = original size)

translation-in-points.description: Translation offset as [x, y] in points

blend-mode.description: Blend mode for compositing a layer or group (Color.BlendMode in Icon Composer)

lighting.description: LiquidGlass.Mode — how lighting is applied across a group

specular-highlight-placement.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Where the specular highlight sits relative to the glass (UI 'Specular Outside'). Requires 'specular-location' in the document's 'features'.

asset-mirroring.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Right-to-left mirroring behaviour for this layer or group's assets.

mirrorable.description: Whether the assets may be mirrored for right-to-left languages

layer.description: A single image layer within a group. Most scalar properties — Color (fill, blend-mode, opacity), LiquidGlass (glass), Composition.Visible (hidden), Composition.Layout (image-name, position) — may be overridden per slot via a corresponding '-specializations' array.

image-name.description: Filename of the image asset in the Assets directory (Composition.Layout)

fill.description: Color fill applied to the layer (Color.Fill)

glass.description: Whether a glass effect is applied (LiquidGlass.Mode)

asset-mirroring.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Right-to-left mirroring behaviour for this layer's assets

shadow.description: Shadow settings for a layer group. Both keys are required; specialize the whole object through the group's 'shadow-specializations'.

kind.description: Shadow kind (JSON value; the Icon Composer UI shows different labels): 'neutral' (UI 'Natural'), 'layer-color' (UI 'Chromatic'), 'none' (UI 'Off'), 'automatic' (inherit).

translucency.description: Translucency settings for a layer group. Both keys are required; specialize the whole object through the group's 'translucency-specializations'.

refractivity.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Refractivity settings for a layer group — how strongly the glass bends what is behind it. All three keys are required; Icon Composer refuses the document if any is missing. Requires 'refractivity' in the document's 'features'.

enabled.description: Whether the refractivity effect is enabled

group.description: A layer group. Carries the LiquidGlass properties — Mode (lighting), Specular, Blur Material, Refractivity, Translucency, Shadow — each with an optional '-specializations' sibling for per-slot overrides.

layers.description: Ordered list of layers in this group

lighting.description: LiquidGlass.Mode — how lighting is applied to the group

specular-highlight-placement.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Where the specular highlight sits (UI 'Specular Outside')

specular-highlight-placement-specializat.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Per-slot specular highlight placement overrides

blur-material.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. LiquidGlass blur material amount (0.0–1.0, default 0.5). This is the key Icon Composer 2 writes; it replaces the Icon Composer 1.x 'blur'.

blur.description: Legacy Icon Composer 1.x LiquidGlass.Blur amount (0.0–1.0). Icon Composer 2 ignores this key — write 'blur-material' instead.

blur-specializations.description: Legacy Icon Composer 1.x per-slot blur overrides. Icon Composer 2 ignores them.

refractivity.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Refractivity settings for the group

refractivity-strength.description: Legacy flat form of 'refractivity.strength'. Icon Composer 2 still reads it, but writes the nested 'refractivity' object.

refractivity-depth.description: Legacy flat form of 'refractivity.depth'. Icon Composer 2 still reads it, but writes the nested 'refractivity' object.

shadow-specializations.description: Per-slot shadow overrides. Icon Composer 2 writes this instead of 'shadow' when the shadow differs per appearance.

blend-mode.description: Blend mode for compositing the whole group

hidden.description: Whether the whole group is hidden

asset-mirroring.description: Icon Composer 2.0+. Right-to-left mirroring behaviour for this group's assets

circles.description: List of platforms using circular icons
